last.verdict: Snap's profits are growing fast, but only because of subscriptions and cost cuts, while advertising grew just 4%.

takeaways.label: Ads barely growing
takeaways.text: Advertising rose only 4%, with brand ad spending down on weaker packaged-goods budgets. Total revenue still grew 14% to $1.72B because subscriptions and other revenue jumped 84%.

takeaways.label: Profit jump
takeaways.text: Adjusted EBITDA (core profit) hit $383M, a 22% margin, against about $337M expected. Net income was $56M versus a $104M loss a year earlier.

takeaways.label: Dropping daily users
takeaways.text: Daily users grew 4% to 495M, short of the roughly 499M expected, and fell 6% in North America. Snap will switch to monthly users (977M) as its main measure from 2027.

takeaways.label: Stronger Q4 outlook
takeaways.text: Q4 revenue is guided to $1.95–1.985B, with the midpoint slightly above the roughly $1.95B analysts expected. Paid subscribers passed 30M, and Specs AR glasses are due to ship this fall.

history.verdict: Revenue beat and a stronger Q3 forecast sent the stock sharply higher.

reasons.label: Big revenue beat
reasons.text: Revenue rose 19% to about $1.6B, above the roughly $1.53B analysts expected.

reasons.label: Upbeat Q3 forecast
reasons.text: Snap guided Q3 revenue to $1.70–1.74B and Adjusted EBITDA (core profit) to $300–350M.

reasons.label: Cost cuts, cash, Specs
reasons.text: Post-layoff cost cuts drove $121M free cash flow; Specs AR glasses got a launch date.
